name: Borrowed Shelter

fieldPatches.label: Gel bed (sugar 0.6 and nutrient 0.2 per cell)

founders.label: Every other founder seeded with Matrix builder

question: Who pays for the film, who benefits?
expectedObservationsText: Forty Crumbsmiths scattered on a round gel bed with sugar. Twenty start with Matrix builder, which spends their energy on film; twenty start without it. Those abilities were given by the recipe and are present at creation: they did not evolve here.
